intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文麻烦线记忆：家里安静、决定做肉派、手上沾满 sticky pastry、电话正好响、用两个粘手指拿 receiver、十分钟才 persuade Helen Bates 晚点再打、mess 扩散到电话和门把手、刚回厨房门铃又响、邮递员要她 sign for a registered letter。读的时候注意 timing words 的重音，长句要按动作分组。

sentences.text: After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：早饭后，她送孩子上学，然后去了商店。After breakfast 后稍停，then 读出动作继续往前走。

sentences.text: The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：孩子在学校，丈夫在上班，家里很安静。at school 和 at work 平行读，quiet 收住，读出安静开场。

sentences.text: In a short time I was busy mixing butter and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：不一会儿，她忙着混合黄油和面粉，手很快沾满粘面皮。长句按 In a short time / mixing butter and flour / covered with sticky pastry 分组。

sentences.text: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：恰好就在那一刻，电话响了。exactly 要读出“偏偏就是这一秒”的倒霉 timing。

sentences.text: Nothing could have been more annoying.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：没有什么比这更烦人了。读出轻微抱怨感，但不用夸张表演。

sentences.text: I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她用两个粘手指拿起话筒，听出 Helen Bates 的声音时很沮丧。receiver 和 between two sticky fingers 要连成清楚画面，recognized 不要读散。

sentences.text: It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她花了十分钟才说服对方晚点再打。It took me ten minutes to 是句型核心，persuade 和 ring back later 是动作核心。

sentences.text: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她刚回厨房，门铃就响了，响得特别夸张。no sooner...than 读出“刚刚...立刻...”的打断感，wake the dead 是夸张说法。
